title: Steve Farris vs. Central Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: The full Standing Judicial Commission judicially declared the complaint out of order because the complainant was not a member of a PCA church and lacked standing; no merits disposition, relief, or remand is stated.
first_summary: The SJC found Case 97-7 judicially out of order because Steve Farris lacked standing before the Commission. The record states no merits ruling or relief.
summary: The Standing Judicial Commission held Steve Farris's complaint against Central Florida Presbytery judicially out of order because Farris was not a member of a PCA church and therefore lacked standing before the Commission. The Commission reached no merits issue and granted no relief; the only stated ground was the complainant's lack of standing. The case illustrates a threshold standing bar for SJC complainants, but the sparse record does not identify the underlying presbytery action complained of.
